4. 新建 examples/pm.py,只实现一个子命令 `wait`:`pm.py wait --ledger-event <事件ID> [--date YYYY-MM-DD] [--timeout 秒] [--interval 秒] [--state-root PATH]`。逻辑:每 interval 秒(默认 20)读 `<state-root>/state/ledger/<date>.jsonl`(默认 ~/core-data/guardian-native,date 默认今天,北京时间),在其中找 `type == "INSTANCE_STATE"` 且 `data.event_id == <事件ID>` 的**最后一行**,当 `data.state.status` ∈ {SUCCEEDED, SUCCEEDED_DEGRADED, FAILED_FINAL, MISSED, SKIPPED_NA, SKIPPED_PHASE} 时,打印一行 `<事件ID> <status> completed_at=<…> last_error=<前120字符>` 并以退出码 0 结束;超时(默认 1700 秒)打印 `TIMEOUT <事件ID> last_status=<…或NONE>` 并以退出码 2 结束。核心判定写成纯函数 `latest_state(lines, event_id) -> dict|None`,不读时钟,便于测试。账本行格式样例(真实):`{"seq":1,"ts":"2026-11-07T00:00:00.045343367+08:00","type":"INSTANCE_STATE","crc32":3636950305,"data":{"event_id":"limit_pool_d1","instance":"limit_pool_d1","trade_date":"2026-11-07","state":{"status":"SKIPPED_NA","attempts":0,"started_at":"","completed_at":"2026-11-07T00:00:00+08:00","last_error":"calendar excluded"}}}`。
5. 测试(新增 ≤3 个):
